alignments.note: Preposition of the heading takes the ASV's For (rule 11).
Assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12).

Participle rendered by the ASV's fixed two-word title Chief Musician. Head moved to Chief under rule 31: the ASV never writes Musician alone for נָצַח (whose lexeme is leading/oversight, rendered to lead, to oversee, to set forward elsewhere), so Musician is the supplied generic and the modifier carries the lexeme, exactly as dry land heads on dry. Competing head Musician, as the English phrase's noun, noted.
Italic A Psalm answers to no morpheme; one contiguous added unit (rules 2, 7).

עַל rendered by the ASV's fixed heading phrase set to; headed on the relational to, since dropping it leaves the phrase stating no relation (rule 24). Competing readings: head on set as the phrase's content word under rule 24's closing paragraph, or set as a supplied added participle with עַל taking only to.
Indefinite article belongs to the noun (rule 15).

review_notes: Superscription; italic A Psalm left added.
Only change: Chief Musician now heads on Chief per rule 31's ASV-usage test (Musician is never written alone for the lexeme); units and edges unchanged.
